definition: חָזַק 291 verb be or grow firm, strong, strengthen (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic חֲזַק bind on or about, gird on , compare Arabic bind, squeeze ) — Qal Perfect ׳ ח Gen 41:57 + 4 t.; חָזָק֑ 2Chr 26:15 suffix חֲזָקוֺ 2Chr 28:20 , etc.; Imperfect יֶהֱז֑ק 2Chr 28:7 ( Baer ) + 2 t.; וַיֶּחֱזַק Gen 41:56 +; יֶחֶזְקוּ 2Sam 10:11 + 2 t.; יֶחְזְקוּ Isa 28:22 Imperative חֲזַק Deut 12:23 +; חִזְקוּ Deut 31:6 +; Infinitive construct לְחָזְקָה 2Kgs 12:13 suffix לְחָזְקָהּ Ezek 30:21 Participle חָזֵק Exod 19:19 ; 2Sam 3:1 , etc.; — I. intransitive be or grow strong: — 1. a. of physical strength of hands Judg 7:11 ; 2Sam 2:7 ; 2Sam 16:21 ; Ezek 22:14 ; Zech 8:9 ; Zech 8:13 (on Ezek 3:14 see below); of arm, followed by infinitive Ezek 30:21 used of recovery from illness Isa 39:1 followed by מִן of comparison over power 1Sam 17:50 (with בְּ instrumental), 2Sam 13:14 . \ \ b. of people, army Deut 11:8 ; Josh 17:13 ( J E ), = Judg 1:28 ; Ezra 9:12 followed by מִן comparative be stronger than, too strong for, prevail against 2Sam 10:11 (twice in verse) = 1Chr 19:12 (twice in verse); 1Kgs 20:23 ; 1Kgs 20:25 id. , followed by accusative 1Kgs 16:22 , compare of ׳ י as prevailing over man Jer 20:7 (|| יָכֹל ); followed by על 2Chr 8:3 ; 2Chr 27:5 . \ \ c. of royal power וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וְהָזֵק 2Sam 3:1 (opposed to הֹלְכִים וְדַלִּים ); compare 2Chr 26:15 (|| חֶזְקָה v 2Chr 26:16 ), Dan 11:5 a. \ \ d. prevail over, upon , of word of king 2Sam 24:4 (followed by אֶלֿ ) = 1Chr 21:4 (followed by עַל ). \ \ e. of bonds Isa 28:22 . feminine of sound of trumpet הוֺלֵךְ וְהָזֵק מְאֹד Exod 19:19 ( E , compare חָזָק v Exod 19:16 ) it grew much louder and louder. 2. be firm, fast: — \ \ a. literally be caught fast , of Absalom's head 2Sam 18:9 (followed by בְּ ). \ \ b. be firm, secure , of a kingdom 2Kgs 14:5 ( + בְּיָדוֺ ) = 2Chr 25:3 ( + עָלָיו ). Oftener \ \ c. be firm = courageous, confident, especially Imperative, usually || אמץ (q. v.), Deut 31:6 ; Deut 31:7 ; Deut 31:23 ; Josh 1:6 ; Josh 1:7 ; Josh 1:9 ; Josh 1:18 ; Josh 10:25 ; Josh 23:6 (all D ), 2Sam 10:12 ; 2Sam 13:28 ; 1Kgs 2:2 ; 1Chr 19:13 (|| התחזק ), 1Chr 22:13 ; 1Chr 28:10 ; 1Chr 28:20 ; 2Chr 15:7 ; 2Chr 19:11 ; 2Chr 32:7 ; Ezra 10:4 ; Ps 27:14 ; Ps 31:25 ; Isa 35:4 ; Isa 41:6 ; Hag 2:4 (3 t. in verse); Dan 10:19 (twice in verse); followed by לַמִּלְחָמָה 2Chr 25:8 . \ \ d. hold firmly to, devote oneself to , followed by בְּ 2Chr 31:4 . \ \ e. followed by Infinitive be firm not to eat blood, i.e. firmly refrain from it Deut 12:23 , compare 1Chr 28:7 . 3. press, be urgent , followed by עַל + Infinitive Exod 12:33 ( E ); followed by עַל of hand of ׳ י in prophetic ecstasy Ezek 3:14 ( ᵐ5 Co read חֲזָקָה , adjective, see חָזָק ). 4. in bad sense: \ \ a. grow stout, rigid, hard , with idea of perversity, of Pharaoh's heart Exod 7:13 ; Exod 7:22 ; Exod 8:15 (all P ), Exod 9:35 ( R ); compare חזקו עָלַי דבריכם Mal 3:13 . \ \ b. be severe, grievous , of battle 2Kgs 3:26 of famine Gen 41:56 ; Gen 41:57 ( E ), Gen 47:20 ( J ; followed by על ), 2Kgs 25:3 = Jer 52:6 . II. transitive only לֹא חֲזֶקוֺ 2Chr 28:20 strengthened him not , but text very dubious (|| וַיָצַר לוֺ ). Pi`el Perfect חִזַּק Ps 147:13 +, etc.; Imperfect וַיְחַזֵּק Exod 9:12 + 10 t., etc.; Imperative חַזֵּק Neh 6:9 + 2 t.; feminine singular חַזְּקִי Nah 3:14 חַזֵּ֑קִי Isa 54:2 etc.; Infinitive construct חַזֵּק 2Kgs 12:9 + 12 t.; Participle מְחַזֵּק Exod 14:17 מְחַזְּקִים 2Kgs 12:9 — 1. make strong (physically): \ \ a. followed by accusative of person Judg 16:28 followed by על Judg 3:12 followed by מָתְנַיִם Nah 2:2 (|| אַמֵּץ כֹּחַ ; of personified people). \ \ b. = restore to strength Dan 10:18 ; Dan 10:19 to health Ezek 34:4 ; Ezek 34:16 with לְ give strength to 1Chr 29:12 so, followed by זְרוֺעֹתָם , Hos 7:15 ; Ezek 30:24 (and v Ezek 30:25 Co , see Hiph`il ) \ \ c. followed by accusative of thing Isa 41:7 ; Jer 10:4 (both with בְּ instrumental; of manufacture of idols); of strengthening tent-pegs, in metaphor Isa 54:4 , compare Isa 33:23 followed by bars of gates Ps 147:13 often of making strong, fortifying a town, etc. Nah 3:14 ; 2Chr 11:11 ; 2Chr 11:12 ; 2Chr 26:9 ; 2Chr 32:5 = repair (wall, object not expressed) Neh 3:19 see Hiph`il; with accusative of temple 2Kgs 12:6 ; 2Kgs 12:7 ; 2Kgs 12:15 ; 2Kgs 22:6 ; 2Kgs 2:5 ; 2Kgs 2:12 ; 2Kgs 29:3 ; 2Kgs 34:8 , compare v 2Chr 34:10 (|| לִבְדּוֺק ); followed by ׳ לְבית י 1Chr 26:27 object breaches (accusative) 2Kgs 12:8 ; 2Kgs 12:9 ; 2Kgs 12:13 ; 2Kgs 22:5 . \ \ d. of establishing kingdom 2Chr 11:17 . 2. strengthen the hands (accusative) of any one, i.e. sustain, encourage (opposed to רִפָּה ) Judg 9:24 ; Jer 23:14 ; Ezek 13:22 ; Isa 35:3 ; Job 4:3 ; Ezra 6:22 ; Neh 2:18 ; Neh 6:9 ; 2Chr 29:34 ידו בֵּאלהים ׳ וַיְח 1Sam 23:16 followed by בְּ Ezra 1:6 ( + בְּ instrumental) 3. make strong = bold, encourage , with accusative Deut 1:38 ; Deut 3:28 ; 2Sam 11:5 ; Isa 41:7 with accusative of person + ׳ לַעֲבֹדַת בֵּית י 2Chr 35:2 . 4. make firm: — \ \ a. with 2 accusative וְאַבְנֵטְךָ אֲחַוְּקֶנּוּ Isa 22:21 and with thy sash (of office) will I make him firm , i.e. bind it firmly about him (|| הלבישׁ ). \ \ b. make firm or fixed , = definitely adopt ֿ ׳ יח לָמוֺ דָּבָר רָע Ps 64:6 . 5. make rigid, hard , i.e. perverse, obstinate, harden (the heart of any one) Exod 4:21 ; Exod 10:20 ; Exod 10:27 (all E ), Exod 9:12 ; Exod 11:10 ; Exod 14:4 ; Exod 14:8 ; Exod 14:17 (all P ), Josh 11:20 ( D ); see also פניהם מִסֶּלַע ׳ ח Jer 5:3 . Hiph`il 118 Perfect הֶחֱזִיק Judg 7:8 +; 3 feminine singular הֶחֱזִ֫יקָה Jer 49:24 +; suffix הֶחֱזִקָ֑תְנִי Jer 8:21 הֶחֱזַ֫קָתִּי Neh 5:16 + 3 t.; וְהַחֲזַקְתִּ֫י Ezek 30:23 , etc.; Imperfect יַחֲזִיק Job 8:15 + 2 t.; 1 singular וְאַחְזֵק Isa 42:6 יַחֲזִיקוּ Jer 6:23 + 2 t.; יַחֲזִקוּ Dan 11:32 , etc.; Imperative הַחֲזֵק 2Sam 11:25 + 2 t., etc.; Infinitive construct הַחֲזִיק 2Kgs 15:19 ; Isa 64:6 suffix הֶחֱזִיקִי Jer 31:32 ( ׳ הַח Manuscript Petrop. see RS JPh xvi, 1888, 73 ); Participle מַחֲזִיק Exod 9:2 + 9 t.; suffix מַחֲזִקָהּ Dan 11:6 feminine singular מַחֲזֶקֶת Neh 4:11 plural מַחֲזִיקִים Neh 4:10 + 5 t.; construct מַחֲוִיקֵי Ezek 27:9 ; Ezek 27:27 — 1. a. make strong, strengthen Jer 51:12 . \ \ b. make firm , the kingdom 2Kgs 15:19 ( + בְּיָדוֺ ). \ \ c. display strength (late) 2Chr 26:8 (|| ׳ וַיֵלֶךְ שְׁמוֺ עַד וגו ), Dan 11:32 (|| וְעָשׂוּ ). 2. make severe , of battle 2Sam 11:25 . 3. followed by יד = support Ezek 16:49 followed by זְרוֺעוֺת Ezek 30:25 (subject ׳ י ; but Co reads Pi`el as v Ezek 30:24 ) . 4. = repair , walls of Jerusalem, Neh 3:4 (3 t. in verse) + 31 t. Neh 3 compare (in general) participle used substantively מחזיקי בדקף Ezek 27:9 ; Ezek 27:27 of Tyre and her ships (|| מַלָּחִים , etc.) 5. prevail , absolute Dan 11:7 followed by עַל Job 18:9 prevail upon to בּוֺ לֶאֱכֹל ׳ הח 2Kgs 4:8 . 6. especially take or keep hold of, seize, grasp: \ \ a. take hold of, seize, catch , followed by בְּ Gen 19:4 ( J ), Gen 21:18 ( E ), Exod 4:4 ( J ; || אחז ), Judg 7:20 ; 1Sam 15:27 ; 2Sam 1:11 ; 1Kgs 1:50 ; 1Kgs 2:28 ; 2Kgs 2:12 ; 2Kgs 4:27 ; Isa 4:1 ; Zech 8:23 (twice in verse); Prov 7:13 ; Prov 26:17 , compare also Judg 19:25 ; Judg 19:29 ; 2Chr 28:15 with violence Deut 22:25 ; Deut 25:11 ; 1Sam 17:35 (perhaps of consecutive frequently, see Dr ), 2Sam 2:16 ; 2Sam 13:11 followed by לְ 2Sam 15:5 figurative take hold in order to lead one (subject ׳ י ) followed by בְּ Jer 31:32 , c accusative Isa 41:9 ; Isa 41:13 compare Isa 51:18 ( בְּ ; || נֵהֵל ); followed by accusative Nah 3:14 take hold of the brick-mould , Jer 6:23 = Jer 50:42 , Zech 14:13 (with violence), Ps 35:2 ; Neh 4:10 ; Neh 4:11 , seize the kingdom Dan 11:21 in metaphor Mic 4:9 ( הֶחֱזִיקֵךְ חִיל ), Jer 6:24 ; Jer 8:21 ; Jer 49:24 (see Gie ), Jer 50:43 of pious laying hold of ׳ י , followed by בְּ Isa 64:6 compare Isa 27:5 ; Isa 56:2 ; Isa 56:4 ; Isa 56:6 of other gods 1Kgs 9:9 = 2Chr 7:22 laying hold of wisdom Prov 3:18 , compare Prov 4:13 ; Job 2:3 ; Job 2:9 ; Job 27:6 ; Jer 8:5 . \ \ b. have or keep hold of , followed by בְּ Judg 16:26 ; 2Sam 3:29 ; Jer 50:33 ; Neh 4:15 . \ \ c. hold up , followed by בְּ , figurative = sustain, support Lev 25:35 of ׳ י holding his servants Isa 42:6 ; Isa 45:1 , compare Job 8:20 see also participle used substantively Dan 11:1 (|| מָעוֺז ), v Dan 11:6 (|| מֵבִיא , יֹלֵד ); of Nehemiah holding fast to his ( בְּ ) his work Neh 5:16 compare of wicked, holding to his house Job 8:15 cleave or cling to ( על ) one's brethren Neh 10:30 . hence \ \ c. keep, retain , followed by בְּ Exod 9:2 ( J ), Judg 7:8 ; חָזַק291 verb be or grow firm, strong, strengthen (Late Hebrew id.; Aramaic חֲזַק bind on or about, gird on, compare Arabic bind, squeeze) —

Qal Perfect ׳ח Gen 41:57 + 4 t.; חָזָק֑ 2Chr 26:15 suffix חֲזָקוֺ 2Chr 28:20, etc.; Imperfect יֶהֱז֑ק 2Chr 28:7 (Baer) + 2 t.; וַיֶּחֱזַק Gen 41:56 +; יֶחֶזְקוּ 2Sam 10:11 + 2 t.; יֶחְזְקוּ Isa 28:22 Imperative חֲזַק Deut 12:23 +; חִזְקוּ Deut 31:6 +; Infinitive construct לְחָזְקָה 2Kgs 12:13 suffix לְחָזְקָהּ Ezek 30:21 Participle חָזֵק Exod 19:19; 2Sam 3:1, etc.; — I. intransitive be or grow strong: —
1. a. of physical strength of hands Judg 7:11; 2Sam 2:7; 2Sam 16:21; Ezek 22:14; Zech 8:9; Zech 8:13 (on Ezek 3:14 see below); of arm, followed by infinitive Ezek 30:21 used of recovery from illness Isa 39:1 followed by מִן of comparison over power 1Sam 17:50 (with בְּ instrumental), 2Sam 13:14.
\ \ b. of people, army Deut 11:8; Josh 17:13 (JE), = Judg 1:28; Ezra 9:12 followed by מִן comparative be stronger than, too strong for, prevail against 2Sam 10:11 (twice in verse) = 1Chr 19:12 (twice in verse); 1Kgs 20:23; 1Kgs 20:25 id., followed by accusative 1Kgs 16:22, compare of ׳י as prevailing over man Jer 20:7 (|| יָכֹל); followed by על 2Chr 8:3; 2Chr 27:5.
\ \ c. of royal power וְדָוִד הֹלֵךְ וְהָזֵק 2Sam 3:1 (opposed to הֹלְכִים וְדַלִּים); compare 2Chr 26:15 (|| חֶזְקָה v2Chr 26:16), Dan 11:5a.
\ \ d. prevail over, upon, of word of king 2Sam 24:4 (followed by אֶלֿ) = 1Chr 21:4 (followed by עַל).
\ \ e. of bonds Isa 28:22. feminine of sound of trumpet הוֺלֵךְ וְהָזֵק מְאֹד Exod 19:19 (E, compare חָזָק vExod 19:16) it grew much louder and louder.
2. be firm, fast: —
\ \ a. literally be caught fast, of Absalom's head 2Sam 18:9 (followed by בְּ).
\ \ b. be firm, secure, of a kingdom 2Kgs 14:5 ( + בְּיָדוֺ) = 2Chr 25:3 ( + עָלָיו). Oftener
\ \ c. be firm = courageous, confident, especially Imperative, usually || אמץ (q. v.), Deut 31:6; Deut 31:7; Deut 31:23; Josh 1:6; Josh 1:7; Josh 1:9; Josh 1:18; Josh 10:25; Josh 23:6 (all D), 2Sam 10:12; 2Sam 13:28; 1Kgs 2:2; 1Chr 19:13 (|| התחזק), 1Chr 22:13; 1Chr 28:10; 1Chr 28:20; 2Chr 15:7; 2Chr 19:11; 2Chr 32:7; Ezra 10:4; Ps 27:14; Ps 31:25; Isa 35:4; Isa 41:6; Hag 2:4 (3 t. in verse); Dan 10:19 (twice in verse); followed byלַמִּלְחָמָה 2Chr 25:8.
\ \ d. hold firmly to, devote oneself to, followed by בְּ 2Chr 31:4.
\ \ e. followed by Infinitive be firm not to eat blood, i.e. firmly refrain from it Deut 12:23, compare 1Chr 28:7.
3. press, be urgent, followed by עַל + Infinitive Exod 12:33 (E); followed by עַל of hand of ׳י in prophetic ecstasy Ezek 3:14 (ᵐ5 Co read חֲזָקָה, adjective, see חָזָק).
4. in bad sense:
\ \ a. grow stout, rigid, hard, with idea of perversity, of Pharaoh's heart Exod 7:13; Exod 7:22; Exod 8:15 (all P), Exod 9:35 (R); compare חזקו עָלַי דבריכם Mal 3:13.
\ \ b. be severe, grievous, of battle 2Kgs 3:26 of famine Gen 41:56; Gen 41:57 (E), Gen 47:20 (J; followed by על), 2Kgs 25:3 = Jer 52:6. II. transitive only לֹא חֲזֶקוֺ 2Chr 28:20 strengthened him not, but text very dubious (|| וַיָצַר לוֺ). Pi`el Perfect חִזַּק Ps 147:13 +, etc.; Imperfect וַיְחַזֵּק Exod 9:12 + 10 t., etc.; Imperative חַזֵּק Neh 6:9 + 2 t.; feminine singular חַזְּקִי Nah 3:14 חַזֵּ֑קִי Isa 54:2 etc.; Infinitive construct חַזֵּק 2Kgs 12:9 + 12 t.; Participle מְחַזֵּק Exod 14:17 מְחַזְּקִים 2Kgs 12:9 —
1. make strong (physically):
\ \ a. followed by accusative of person Judg 16:28 followed by על Judg 3:12 followed by מָתְנַיִם Nah 2:2 (|| אַמֵּץ כֹּחַ; of personified people).
\ \ b. = restore to strength Dan 10:18; Dan 10:19 to health Ezek 34:4; Ezek 34:16 with לְ give strength to 1Chr 29:12 so, followed by זְרוֺעֹתָם, Hos 7:15; Ezek 30:24 (and vEzek 30:25 Co, see Hiph`il)
\ \ c. followed by accusative of thing Isa 41:7; Jer 10:4 (both with בְּ instrumental; of manufacture of idols); of strengthening tent-pegs, in metaphor Isa 54:4, compare Isa 33:23 followed by bars of gates Ps 147:13 often of making strong, fortifying a town, etc. Nah 3:14; 2Chr 11:11; 2Chr 11:12; 2Chr 26:9; 2Chr 32:5 = repair (wall, object not expressed) Neh 3:19 see Hiph`il; with accusative of temple 2Kgs 12:6; 2Kgs 12:7; 2Kgs 12:15; 2Kgs 22:6; 2Kgs 2:5; 2Kgs 2:12; 2Kgs 29:3; 2Kgs 34:8, compare v2Chr 34:10 (|| לִבְדּוֺק); followed by ׳לְבית י 1Chr 26:27 object breaches (accusative) 2Kgs 12:8; 2Kgs 12:9; 2Kgs 12:13; 2Kgs 22:5.
\ \ d. of establishing kingdom 2Chr 11:17.
2. strengthen the hands (accusative) of any one, i.e. sustain, encourage (opposed to רִפָּה) Judg 9:24; Jer 23:14; Ezek 13:22; Isa 35:3; Job 4:3; Ezra 6:22; Neh 2:18; Neh 6:9; 2Chr 29:34 ידו בֵּאלהים ׳וַיְח 1Sam 23:16 followed by בְּ Ezra 1:6 ( + בְּ instrumental)
3. make strong = bold, encourage, with accusative Deut 1:38; Deut 3:28; 2Sam 11:5; Isa 41:7 with accusative of person + ׳לַעֲבֹדַת בֵּית י 2Chr 35:2.
4. make firm: —
\ \ a. with 2 accusative וְאַבְנֵטְךָ אֲחַוְּקֶנּוּ Isa 22:21 and with thy sash (of office) will I make him firm, i.e. bind it firmly about him (|| הלבישׁ).
\ \ b. make firm or fixed, = definitely adopt ֿ׳יח לָמוֺ דָּבָר רָע Ps 64:6.
5. make rigid, hard, i.e. perverse, obstinate, harden (the heart of any one) Exod 4:21; Exod 10:20; Exod 10:27 (all E), Exod 9:12; Exod 11:10; Exod 14:4; Exod 14:8; Exod 14:17 (all P), Josh 11:20 (D); see also פניהם מִסֶּלַע ׳ח Jer 5:3 . \ \ b. make firm, the kingdom 2Kgs 15:19 ( + בְּיָדוֺ).
\ \ c. display strength (late) 2Chr 26:8 (|| ׳וַיֵלֶךְ שְׁמוֺ עַד וגו), Dan 11:32 (|| וְעָשׂוּ).
2. make severe, of battle 2Sam 11:25.
